name: What data does AEO use to optimize a construction company's online presence?
description: AEO uses website analytics, keyword data, competitor insights, industry trends, and local search data to optimize a construction company's online presence.

mainEntity.name: What data does AEO use to optimize a construction company's online presence?

acceptedAnswer.text: AEO systems for construction companies leverage various data points to inform optimization strategies. This includes website analytics (traffic, bounce rates, conversions), keyword performance data, competitor search rankings and strategies, industry trends, and local search data. AI continuously processes this information to identify opportunities for improvement, predict future search behavior, and refine content and technical SEO recommendations for maximum effectiveness.
